system: You are the Planner of a nonprofit-finance theory-testing pipeline. You turn a theory into a JSON test spec in the exact format shown. You choose variables, the expected sign, the unit the exposure is assigned to and controls; you never compute a statistic. The validation gate (alpha, effect floor, permutations, hold-out) is fixed by the pipeline and replaces whatever you write. Use only the column names listed. Reply with one JSON object and nothing else.
prompt:
Theory: Poor community health eats into nonprofits' bottom line.

Scout mapping: {"outcome": "operating_margin", "exposure": "chr_poor_fair_health", "exposure_type": "continuous", "exposure_unit": "county_fips", "controls": ["log_revenue", "poverty_rate", "median_household_income", "unemployment_rate", "chr_uninsured", "chr_hs_completion", "category", "state", "tax_year", "return_type"], "notes": "Poor community health is proxied by the county share of adults in poor or fair health (compare within tax year because of the 2020 level shift), with operating margin as the bottom-line outcome and economic, education and insurance conditions plus size, sector, state and year as controls (restrict to 990 filers)."}

Example spec for a binary exposure (follow this format exactly):
{
  "spec_version": 1,
  "theory_id": "ratings_fairness",
  "theory": "Standard financial-ratio ratings unfairly penalize nonprofits in high-need counties.",
  "source": "docs/ratings_theory.md",
  "written_by": "hand (CP3); from CP4 the Planner agent writes specs in this format",
  "outcome": "standard_rating",
  "exposure": "high_need",
  "expected_sign": -1,
  "exposure_unit": "county_fips",
  "exposure_varies_by": "tax_year",
  "population": {
    "return_type": ["990"],
    "require_true": ["has_county", "has_need"],
    "require_present": ["standard_rating", "high_need", "log_revenue", "category", "county_fips"]
  },
  "hypotheses": [
    {
      "id": "H1",
      "claim": "The mean standard rating is lower in high-need counties than elsewhere.",
      "method": "difference_in_means"
    },
    {
      "id": "H2",
      "claim": "The gap remains after controlling for organization size (log revenue), sector (NORP category) and tax year.",
      "method": "fixed_effects",
      "controls": ["log_revenue"],
      "absorb": ["tax_year", "category"],
      "cluster": "county_fips"
    }
  ],
  "robustness": [
    {
      "id": "H2_multilevel_2022",
      "method": "multilevel",
      "controls": ["log_revenue"],
      "categorical": ["category"],
      "group": "county_fips",
      "years": [2022]
    },
    {
      "id": "H2_county_year_means",
      "method": "two_stage_group_means",
      "controls": ["log_revenue"],
      "absorb": ["tax_year", "category"],
      "groups": ["county_fips", "tax_year"]
    }
  ],
  "validator": {
    "alpha": 0.05,
    "effect_floor_sd": 0.1,
    "n_permutations": 999,
    "seed": 6235,
    "permutation": {"keep_paths": true, "studentized": true},
    "holdout": {"by": "state", "folds": 5},
    "holdout_year": 2022
  }
}


For exposure_type "continuous", set hypotheses H1.method to "correlation". Use the Scout's outcome, exposure, exposure_type and exposure_unit unchanged. Give a fresh theory_id (snake_case).
text:
{
  "spec_version": 1,
  "theory_id": "community_health_operating_margin",
  "theory": "Poor community health eats into nonprofits' bottom line.",
  "source": "Scout mapping for theory: Poor community health eats into nonprofits' bottom line.",
  "written_by": "Planner agent",
  "outcome": "operating_margin",
  "exposure": "chr_poor_fair_health",
  "exposure_type": "continuous",
  "expected_sign": -1,
  "exposure_unit": "county_fips",
  "exposure_varies_by": "tax_year",
  "population": {
    "return_type": ["990"],
    "require_true": ["has_county"],
    "require_present": ["operating_margin", "chr_poor_fair_health", "log_revenue", "poverty_rate", "median_household_income", "unemployment_rate", "chr_uninsured", "chr_hs_completion", "category", "state", "county_fips"]
  },
  "hypotheses": [
    {
      "id": "H1",
      "claim": "Operating margin is negatively correlated with the county share of adults in poor or fair health.",
      "method": "correlation"
    },
    {
      "id": "H2",
      "claim": "The negative association remains after controlling for organization size, county economic, education and insurance conditions, and absorbing sector, state and tax year.",
      "method": "fixed_effects",
      "controls": ["log_revenue", "poverty_rate", "median_household_income", "unemployment_rate", "chr_uninsured", "chr_hs_completion"],
      "absorb": ["tax_year", "category", "state"],
      "cluster": "county_fips"
    }
  ],
  "robustness": [
    {
      "id": "H2_multilevel_2022",
      "method": "multilevel",
      "controls": ["log_revenue", "poverty_rate", "median_household_income", "unemployment_rate", "chr_uninsured", "chr_hs_completion"],
      "categorical": ["category", "state"],
      "group": "county_fips",
      "years": [2022]
    },
    {
      "id": "H2_county_year_means",
      "method": "two_stage_group_means",
      "controls": ["log_revenue", "poverty_rate", "median_household_income", "unemployment_rate", "chr_uninsured", "chr_hs_completion"],
      "absorb": ["tax_year", "category", "state"],
      "groups": ["county_fips", "tax_year"]
    }
  ],
  "validator": {
    "alpha": 0.05,
    "effect_floor_sd": 0.1,
    "n_permutations": 999,
    "seed": 6235,
    "permutation": {"keep_paths": true, "studentized": true},
    "holdout": {"by": "state", "folds": 5},
    "holdout_year": 2022
  }
}
